_meta.scope: commands, ecs, events, spawning, math, common, procedurallib

commands.note: All 30 modified builtin commands follow the same ObjectList->List pattern; 6 sampled for pattern confirmation

commands.summary: 22 changed types: 1 new argument type (GREEDY_STRING), 3 removed commands (GitCommand tree), 4 framework files modified (AbstractCommand, Tokenizer, ParserContext, AbbreviationMap), 4 argument/type files modified (ArgumentType, ArgTypes, AbstractTargetEntityCommand, CommandListPage), ~30 builtin commands updated to use java.util.List instead of ObjectList. Greedy string argument is a notable new feature.

GREEDY_STRING_argument_type.description: New argument type that consumes all remaining input as a single string. When a RequiredArg uses GREEDY_STRING, AbstractCommand.processRequiredArguments() extracts the raw tail of the command input (everything after the subcommand path and preceding required args) and passes it as one string to the argument parser.

related_changes.ArgumentType.isGreedyString(): New method returning false by default; GREEDY_STRING overrides to return true.
related_changes.AbstractCommand.hasGreedyStringArg: New boolean field. Set to true when a greedy string arg is registered. Prevents registering additional required args after it. Also sets allowsExtraArguments=true automatically.
related_changes.AbstractCommand.extractGreedyRawTail(): New method. Uses ParserContext.getRawInput() and subCommandIndex to strip preceding tokens and return the remaining raw input.
related_changes.ParserContext.rawInput: New field storing the original raw command input string. Exposed via getRawInput().
related_changes.ParserContext.getSubCommandIndex(): New accessor for the subcommand depth counter.

GREEDY_STRING_argument_type.first_consumer: SudoCommand now uses GREEDY_STRING for its command argument instead of manual raw string parsing with CommandUtil.stripCommandName()

GitCommand.description: Git-based asset/prefab update command tree removed entirely. GitCommand was a collection with two subcommands for pulling asset and prefab updates via git.

UpdateAssetsCommand.description: Subcommand of GitCommand. Removed with parent.

UpdatePrefabsCommand.description: Subcommand of GitCommand. Removed with parent.

changes: Added hasGreedyStringArg field and validation preventing args after greedy string
Added extractGreedyRawTail() method for greedy string support
processRequiredArguments() now short-circuits for greedy string args
Registration validation logic restructured (condition order inverted)
Constructor now takes rawInput:String parameter
Static factory ParserContext.of() updated accordingly
Added getRawInput() and getSubCommandIndex() accessors
Optional arg name regex changed from --(\w*) to --([\w-]*) — now allows hyphens in arg names
Matchers are now local variables instead of static fields (thread-safety improvement)
Removed GitCommand registration from registerSystemCommand() calls
ParserContext.of() call updated to pass rawInput
Quote handling fix: tokenStart==i check added when opening a quoted string at position i (prevents treating mid-token quotes as string delimiters)
Complete rewrite of abbreviation lookup algorithm
Old: HashMap with pre-computed prefix entries; ambiguous prefixes nulled out
New: Linear scan over List<Pair<String,Value>> with three-tier matching: exact match (immediate return) > unambiguous prefix match > unambiguous substring match
Builder simplified: no longer generates prefix entries, just stores key-value pairs
Adds substring matching as a fallback — commands can now match by substring, not just prefix

ArgumentType.change: Added isGreedyString() method returning false by default

changes: Added GREEDY_STRING static final field
BLOCK_MASK type now validates for invalid blocks via BlockFilter.parseComponents() and reports which blocks are invalid

AbstractTargetEntityCommand.change: Changed execute() signature from ObjectList<Ref<EntityStore>> to java.util.List<Ref<EntityStore>>. Internal list creation changed from ObjectArrayList to ReferenceArrayList. ObjectLists.singleton() to ReferenceLists.singleton().

changes: Description display moved from subcommand/variant rendering to the shared command display method (was being set before, now centralized)
Variant suffix now uses i18n translation key 'server.customUI.commandListPage.variantSuffix' instead of hardcoded '[Variant]' string

builtin_commands_pattern.description: ~30 builtin commands changed uniformly due to AbstractTargetEntityCommand signature change (ObjectList->List). All entity-targeting commands (EntityIntangible, EntityInvulnerable, EntityHideFromAdventurePlayers, EntityMakeInteractable, EntityEffect, EntityStats*, EntitySnapshotHistory, etc.) updated their execute() signatures and iterator usage.
builtin_commands_pattern.typical_change_pattern: ObjectList<Ref<EntityStore>> -> List<Ref<EntityStore>>, ObjectListIterator removal, explicit casts removed, for-each loop style modernized

SudoCommand.description: Beyond the List pattern change, SudoCommand was significantly refactored to use the new GREEDY_STRING argument type.
changes: Uses new RequiredArg<String> with ArgTypes.GREEDY_STRING instead of manual CommandUtil.stripCommandName() raw parsing
Removed setAllowsExtraArguments(true) — now automatically set by greedy string registration
Simplified control flow: removed nested if blocks, flattened the execution logic
Removed CommandUtil import dependency

ecs.summary: 7 changed types: 2 new types (EntityHolderEventType, EntityHolderEventSystem), 5 modified types (Ref, Holder, ComponentAccessor, ComponentRegistry, Store, CommandBuffer, ArchetypeChunk, SpatialResource). The major addition is a new 'holder-scoped' ECS event dispatch mechanism alongside the existing entity and world event types.

EntityHolderEventType.description: New event dispatch type for ECS events scoped to a Holder rather than a Ref. Unlike EntityEventType which dispatches to entities already in a Store, EntityHolderEventType dispatches using Holder<ECS_TYPE> — suitable for events on entities not yet fully committed to the store or in a transitional state.

EntityHolderEventSystem.description: Handler for EntityHolderEventType events. Receives the Holder directly instead of an index+ArchetypeChunk pair. Query-based archetype matching still applies (tests Holder.getArchetype()). handleInternal() checks shouldProcessEvent() for cancellation before calling handle().

Ref.change: validate() now returns int (the entity index) instead of void. Validation order changed: checks for MIN_VALUE index first, then checks store equality. Callers can now use the returned index directly instead of calling getIndex() separately — avoids a redundant volatile read.

Holder.change: addComponent() refactored: extracted addComponentInternal() which returns boolean (true if component was added, false if archetype already contained it). addComponent() calls addComponentInternal() and throws on false. This supports Store.addComponent() which needs rollback on duplicate.

ComponentAccessor.change: Added two new invoke methods for holder-scoped events: invoke(Holder, Event) and invoke(EntityHolderEventType, Holder, Event).

CommandBuffer.change: Added invoke(Holder, Event) and invoke(EntityHolderEventType, Holder, Event) which delegate to Store.internal_invoke(). These mirror the ComponentAccessor additions.

changes: Added entityHolderEventTypeClassToIndex map (Object2IntMap)
Added registerEntityHolderEventType0() and unregisterEntityHolderEventType0() private methods — manages EntityHolderEventType lifecycle with index reuse from the shared systemType pool
Auto-registration: when registering a system that is an EntityHolderEventSystem, auto-registers its event type if not already present
Added unregisterEntityHolderEventType() public method
Added getEntityHolderEventTypeForClass() public lookup method
Added internal_invoke(CommandBuffer, Holder, Event) — dispatches to all matching EntityHolderEventSystems based on Holder's archetype
Added internal_invoke(CommandBuffer, EntityHolderEventType, Holder, Event) — dispatches to specific EntityHolderEventType systems
validate() calls now use returned index directly (Ref.validate() return value change)
Thread equality checks changed from .equals() to == (reference identity, faster)
addComponent() refactored: uses Holder.addComponentInternal(), on failure (duplicate component) rolls back the archetype chunk removal and re-adds the entity to its original archetype before throwing
Array indexing throughout refactored from componentType.getIndex() to loop variable i — avoids redundant virtual calls
removeEntityAndProvideComponents() now fills sub-minIndex range with null via Arrays.fill()
Minor: raw type usage for Component[] array initialization

SpatialResource.change: ThreadLocal<ObjectList<Ref<?>>> changed to ThreadLocal<List<Ref<?>>>. ObjectArrayList replaced with ReferenceArrayList (identity-based equality for Ref objects). Return type of getThreadLocalReferenceList() changed from ObjectList to List.

events.summary: 3 changed types: 1 new event (RemovedPlayerFromWorldEvent), 1 removed event (LivingEntityInventoryChangeEvent), 1 modified event (AddPlayerToWorldEvent). Also: EventBus dispatch safety fix and PlayerSetupConnectEvent reason type change.

RemovedPlayerFromWorldEvent.description: New event fired when a player is removed from a world. Mirrors AddPlayerToWorldEvent structure. Provides the Holder (not Ref) since the entity may already be removed from the store. Supports mutable leave message and broadcast toggle.

LivingEntityInventoryChangeEvent.description: Event fired when a living entity's inventory changed, providing ItemContainer and Transaction. Removed entirely — inventory change tracking likely moved to an ECS event or handled differently.

Constructor now takes joinMessage parameter
Added getJoinMessage() and setJoinMessage(Message) accessors
shouldBroadcastJoinMessage() now also checks joinMessage != null (was only checking broadcastJoinMessage boolean)

EventBus.change: dispatchFor() and dispatchForAsync() now check registry.isAlive() in addition to null check before dispatching. Returns NO_OP dispatcher for dead registries. Prevents dispatching events to registries that have been shut down.

changes: reason field type changed from String to Message (i18n support)
DEFAULT_REASON changed from raw string to Message.translation('client.general.disconnect.setupCancelled')
getReason() returns Message instead of String
setReason() takes Message instead of String
UUID parameter annotated @Nonnull

spawning.summary: 6 changed types: SpawnMarkerBlockState replaced by SpawnMarkerBlock (block-state to ECS component migration), plus widespread collection type modernization (Object2DoubleMap->Reference2DoubleMap, ObjectArrayList->ReferenceArrayList, Set->List for chunk refs). Several null-safety improvements in world spawning.

SpawnMarkerBlock.description: Replacement for SpawnMarkerBlockState. Migrated from the BlockState metadata system to a regular ECS Component<ChunkStore>. The config (spawn marker ID and offset) is now stored in the Data inner class with its own BuilderCodec, rather than being embedded in the block type's state data.

SpawnMarkerBlockState.description: Replaced by SpawnMarkerBlock component. SpawnMarkerBlockState extended BlockState (part of the block metadata system); the new SpawnMarkerBlock implements Component<ChunkStore> directly. The Data inner class similarly changed from extending StateData to a standalone codec class.

changes: Added spawnMarkerBlockComponentType field (ComponentType<ChunkStore, SpawnMarkerBlock>)
Registration changed from BlockStateModule.registerBlockState(SpawnMarkerBlockState) to getChunkStoreRegistry().registerComponent(SpawnMarkerBlock)
SpawnMarkerBlockStateSystems now initialized with the new component type instead of BlockStateModule lookup
Added getSpawnMarkerBlockComponentType() accessor
Major refactor of AddOrRemove system to work with SpawnMarkerBlock component instead of SpawnMarkerBlockState
Block state data now resolved via BlockChunk block lookup -> BlockType.getBlockEntity() -> getComponent(SpawnMarkerBlock.getComponentType()) chain instead of direct state cast
Block position now computed from chunk-local coordinates via ChunkUtil.worldCoordFromLocalCoord() instead of from the old BlockState.getBlockPosition()
Added BlockModule.BlockStateInfo parameter to spawn marker creation flow
Null-safety: added checks for null blockChunk, blockType, blockEntity, configType, and data

WorldEnvironmentSpawnData.change: chunkRefSet:Set<Ref<ChunkStore>> replaced with chunkRefList:List<Ref<ChunkStore>> using ReferenceArrayList. Renamed accessor from getChunkRefSet() to getChunkRefList().

Multiple assert-then-use patterns replaced with null checks returning safe defaults (false or 0.0). Specifically: ChunkSpawnData null check returns false for isRoleSpawnable, SpawnChunkData null check returns 0.0 for spawn weight calculation

SpawnStatsCommand.change: Updated reference from getChunkRefSet() to getChunkRefList()

ObjectList -> List for SpatialResource results

TriggerSpawnMarkersInteraction.change: ObjectArrayList -> ReferenceArrayList for spawner and trigger lists

spawning.collection_migration_rationale: Widespread replacement of fastutil Object-based collections (ObjectArrayList, Object2DoubleOpenHashMap, ObjectList) with Reference-based equivalents (ReferenceArrayList, Reference2DoubleOpenHashMap). This is a performance optimization: Ref objects use reference identity (==) rather than value equality (.equals()), and Reference-based collections exploit this for faster lookups and comparisons. This aligns with the Store.java changes where Thread.equals() was replaced with == throughout.

math.summary: 7 changed types: 5 removed (Mat4f, Quatf, Vec2f, Vec3f, Vec4f), 2 modified (Box.forEachBlock overflow fix, ChunkUtil validation methods, Vector3d.assign(Vector3i) overload).

Mat4f.description: Immutable 4x4 float matrix for ByteBuf network serialization (16 float fields, SIZE=64). Removed — network serialization likely refactored or the type consolidated.

Quatf.description: Immutable quaternion (x,y,z,w floats) for ByteBuf network serialization. Removed alongside other network-serialization math types.

Vec2f.description: Lightweight 2D float vector for ByteBuf serialization. Removed.

Vec3f.description: Lightweight 3D float vector for ByteBuf serialization. Removed.

Vec4f.description: Immutable 4D float vector for ByteBuf serialization. Removed.

removed.removal_rationale: All five removed types were lightweight ByteBuf-serialization wrappers with no arithmetic operations. They were used purely for network protocol encoding. Their removal suggests the network protocol was refactored to use different serialization types or inline byte writing.

Box.change: forEachBlock() iteration loops now include overflow guards: 'for (int _x = minX; _x <= maxX && _x >= minX; _x++)'. The '&& _x >= minX' clause prevents integer overflow when maxX is near Integer.MAX_VALUE causing _x to wrap to Integer.MIN_VALUE and loop infinitely. Applied to all three nested loops in both forEachBlock overloads.

changes: Added MIN_CHUNK_COORD (-67108864) and MAX_CHUNK_COORD (67108863) constants
Added isValidChunkIndex(long) — validates both x and z coordinates of a packed chunk index
Added isValidChunkCoords(int, int) — validates a pair of chunk coordinates
Added isValidChunkCoord(int) — checks that a single coordinate is within [-67108864, 67108863]
These bounds correspond to a 26-bit signed range, consistent with the chunk index packing format

Vector3d.change: Added assign(Vector3i) overload — assigns this Vector3d's x/y/z from a Vector3i's integer components. Drops cached hash. Returns this for fluent chaining.

common.summary: 2 changed types (content modifications only, no adds/removes): BucketItemPool performance rewrite, StringUtil deprecated method removal, Semver build metadata validation fix.

changes: Internal pool changed from ObjectArrayList (List-based) to raw BucketItem[] array with manual size tracking
addAll() now uses System.arraycopy with dynamic array growth instead of List.addAll
acquire() uses direct array index decrement instead of List.remove(size-1)
Nulls out released slots explicitly (pool[--size] = null)
Performance optimization: eliminates List overhead for this hot-path object pool
Removed deprecated parseArgs(String, Map<String,String>) method (~100 lines) — was marked @Deprecated(forRemoval=true)
Removed parseArgs(String) method (~70 lines)
Removed removeQuotes(String) helper method
These methods handled command-line argument parsing with quote/escape handling — functionality now fully handled by the command system's Tokenizer

Semver.change: Build metadata validation rewritten. Old: simple isAlphaNumericHyphenString() check. New: character-by-character validation allowing dot-separated identifiers per SemVer 2.0.0 spec. Each identifier must be [0-9A-Za-z-], dots separate identifiers, no empty identifiers (no leading/trailing/consecutive dots). Error messages updated to reference the spec: 'Build identifiers must only contain ASCII alphanumerics and hyphens [0-9A-Za-z-]'

procedurallib.summary: 1 changed type: JsonLoader base class gains shared static constants; BlendNoisePropertyJsonLoader updated to use them.

JsonLoader.change: Added two protected static final fields: EMPTY_OBJECT (new JsonObject()) and EMPTY_ARRAY (new JsonArray()). These provide shared empty default values for subclasses to use in mustGet calls, avoiding repeated allocation.

BlendNoisePropertyJsonLoader.change: mustGetArray() calls changed from BlendNoisePropertyJsonLoader.Constants.EMPTY_ARRAY to the inherited EMPTY_ARRAY constant. The inner Constants class (which presumably held EMPTY_ARRAY) is no longer referenced — the constant was hoisted to the base class.
